newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian helicopter crashes with three on board.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian helicopter crashes with three on board.

text.p: A helicopter crashed near the eastern Malaysian town of Kuala Lipis late on Monday with three people on board, the national Bernama news agency said on Tuesday.

The helicopter, an Augusta-109, was owned by Gadek Aviation, and was on a flight from Kuala Lumpur to the northern town of Kuala Terengganu, said Bernama, quoting a statement by the Department of Civil Aviation.
The fate of the three occupants was unkown, said Bernama.
